description: Astra supplies the actual committed data schema: every full record contains seed,strength,family,full probability arrays; each large-frame record contains seed,strength,unitary hash and full_distribution_executed=false. Full distributions stop at m12, whereas m32/64/128 calculate certificates only. Propose one necessary scope check and one implementation risk. Do not allege seeds are missing; they are explicitly present. This is schema interpretation, not an independent code audit. At most 100 words.
